 MSU-Washington football kickoff time pushed back 
 By WILX News 10 Published : Nov. 14, 2026 at 12:41 AM EST | Updated : 16 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google EAST LANSING, Mich. - Due to a delay in travel caused by Friday’s nationwide ground stop, Saturday’s football game between Michigan State and the University of Washington will begin at 5:30 p.m.
 Kickoff had previously been set for 4:15 p.m., but the Huskies’ flight out of Seattle was delayed by several hours due to the ground stop.
 RELATED COVERAGE: 
 Travelers face disruption at Lansing’s Capital Region International Airport during hours-long ground stop 
 Trump administration blames ‘overloaded’ systems for ground stop after FAA lets flights resume 
 Parking lots will open at 7 a.m. The MSUFCU Club & Suites and the student section gates will open at 3:30 p.m. All other Spartan Stadium gates will open at 4 p.m.
 The game will be televised by Big Ten Network.
